name: foam-rolling-lats
instructions:
1. In a supine position, position the foam roller near your armpit at the base of your lat.
2. Raise one arm overhead, pick your hips up off the floor, and roll from the base of your ribcage up into the armpit region.
3. Adjust pressure into the roller by raising your hips higher or lower or applying more force through your free hand into the ground.
4. Slowly roll up and down the length of the thoracic spine for 20-30 seconds.
5. Repeat on the other side.
starting_position: 1. In a supine position, position the foam roller near your armpit at the base of your lat. 2. Raise one arm overhead, pick your hips up off the floor, and roll from the base of your ribcage up into the armpit region.
